summary: Iteration 7 – Validated PDF attachment on inspections and new Chambre Chronique/SAS/Urgence equipments with linked maintenances. Both backend (pytest 12/12) and frontend flows pass with 0 runtime errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Chambres created via link_chambers.py store the display name in the `reference` field (not `nom`, which is None). This is consistent with existing equipments (BAUER 01, etc.) — acceptable but a small inconsistency: some tests initially assumed `nom`. Might be worth aligning schema/docs.

Inspections.jsx PDF section is clean: data-testids properly set (pdf-section, upload-pdf-btn, pdf-file-input, pdf-doc-item, delete-pdf-btn). PDF URL built from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as required.
Backend POST /api/inspections/{id}/procedures correctly validates PDF extension (400 for non-PDF), pushes to procedure_documents, and delete pulls by url + removes file.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test PDF was uploaded then deleted in both backend pytest and Playwright flow (0→1→0). No orphan files left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF upload works via POST /api/inspections/{id}/procedures (multipart 'file'), URL served at /api/uploads/inspections/<uuid>.pdf. Non-PDF => 400. Delete via DELETE with query param doc_url. The 3 chambres are stored with reference='Chambre Chronique|SAS|Urgence' and type='Chambre hyperbare' (nom is None). IDs: Chronique=960b8314-ae8e-4e2f-9217-49b59c36ac52, SAS=0d19c402-a307-41ab-9428-48b13bc0974c, Urgence=1586d6cf-0cb2-4ae0-ac76-0901d4be9e86. History futures counts: Chronique=39, SAS=35, Urgence=38. Equipment detail modal opened via [data-testid='equipment-actions-{id}'] dropdown then 'Voir détails' menu item. Regression sweep OK: dashboard global search (23 results for 'BAUER'), /planning, /maintenance-preventive all load without errors.
